entities.summary: Irina Ivanovna Saltykova is a Russian pop singer and a former member of the music group Mirage, which was popular in Russia in the 1990s. She released six albums and four singles. She also did some acting, particularly in the film Brother 2. In June 2000, was featured in Russian Playboy.
